name: std::ranges::views::take, std::ranges::take_view

class take_view

template< class T >

constexpr bool enable_borrowed_range<std::ranges::take_view<T>> =


    ranges::enable_borrowed_range<T>;
  
 (since C++20)

This specialization of std::ranges::enable_borrowed_range makes take_view satisfy borrowed_range when the underlying view satisfies it.

summary: 1) A range adaptor that represents view of the elements from an underlying sequence, starting at the beginning and ending at a given bound.
